purpose: Albedo texture for the Authority Nexus underside brass containment collar
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production diffuse/albedo texture tile for a brass containment ring on a hard-surface sci-fi station, Authority Nexus.

Create one wide 3:1 landscape material texture, about 3072 by 1024 pixels, completely filled edge to edge with machined warm muted gold/brass metal. This is the FLAT MATERIAL itself for UV mapping, not a picture of a ring, station, object, or environment.

Layout: TWO broad horizontal strips of aligned rectangular brass armor panels, the upper strip spanning approximately y=0%-50% and the lower strip y=50%-100%. The panel seams in each strip line up horizontally between the strips. Each strip contains four or five long rectangular panels separated by narrow dark engraved vertical seams. Fine double engraved lines and shallow recessed borders run horizontally near the top and bottom of each strip. Small dark countersunk fasteners in restrained pairs are spaced near the long edges. Add tiny inset service plates, short vent grooves and a few interlocking chamfered joints. Keep the panel layout orderly and structural, with enough detail to read when wrapped around a thin ring. The center of each panel remains clean brass with subtle brushed grain and tonal variation, not large empty flat color.

Material: sophisticated aged-but-well-maintained golden brass or bronze alloy. Desaturated honey gold, soft brown brass undertones, dark gunmetal seams, faint brighter edge wear. No ivory, no chrome, no painted warning stripes, no rust, no stains or heavy damage. Microscopic machining lines and subtle scratches. Match the restrained brass hardware of an elegant pale-ivory science-fiction space station.

Perfectly straight-on orthographic material scan. Even diffuse illumination everywhere, no directional highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette or lighting gradient. Only shallow local seam and bevel shading. Horizontally seamless/tileable: left and right edges must join cleanly. No wide black outer frame. No perspective.
No text, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark, glows, cyan lights, pipes, cables, exposed electronics, stars, station silhouettes, rings, separate objects or background. Deliver only the flat albedo texture.
